DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 詰め物を入れました。今、軽く噛んでみてどうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: The filling is in. How does it feel when you bite gently now?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 右の奥歯だけ、先に当たる感じがします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 右奥歯だけ先に当たる違和感を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Only my back right tooth feels like it touches first.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Describe the uncomfortable feeling that only the back right tooth touches first. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どのあたりが当たりますか。この紙を噛んでみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where does it touch? Please bite on this paper.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ここです。普通に口を閉じても、少し高い感じがします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 当たる位置と口を閉じたときの高さを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here. Even closing my mouth normally, it feels a little high.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the contact point and the height when closing your mouth. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 当たる部分を少し調整しますね。痛みはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll adjust the contact area a little. Is there any pain?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今は痛くありません。麻酔で唇の感覚がまだ鈍いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 痛みがないことと麻酔の状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Not now. My lip is still numb from the anesthetic.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say there's no pain and describe the anesthetic's effect. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 調整できました。もう一度噛んで、左右の感じを比べてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: That's adjusted. Bite again and compare the left and right sides.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: さっきより自然です。麻酔が切れるまで食事は待ったほうがいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 調整後の改善を伝えて食事の時期を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It's more natural than before. Should I wait until the anesthetic wears off before eating?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report improvement after adjustment and ask when to eat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、感覚が戻ってからにしてください。強い痛みや腫れが出たら医院へ連絡してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, wait until sensation returns. Contact the clinic if you have severe pain or swelling.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: わかりました。感覚が戻ってから食べて、強く痛む場合は電話します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 食事と強い痛みへの対応を自分の言葉で確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll eat after sensation returns, and phone if it hurts badly.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm eating and response to severe pain in your own words. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでお願いします。今日はお疲れさまでした、お大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please do. Thank you for today; take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こんにちは。何かお困りですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子どもの帽子を落としました。青い帽子は届いていませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 青い子どもの帽子の落とし物を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: My child lost a hat. Has a blue hat been handed in?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a lost blue child's hat. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらに一つ届いています。どんな形で、何か目印はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: One has been handed in here. What shape is it, and does it have any identifying marks?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: つばのある帽子で、横に白い星が付いています。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 帽子の形と白い星の目印を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It has a brim and a white star on the side.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Describe the hat's shape and white-star identifying mark. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その帽子に似ていますね。いつごろ、どこでなくしましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: It sounds like that hat. When and where did you lose it?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二十分ほど前です。滑り台のそばで脱いだと思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: なくした時刻と滑り台付近という場所を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: About twenty minutes ago. I think we took it off beside the slide.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Give the time and location near the slide where it was lost. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: それなら、私がそのあたりで拾ったものかもしれません。内側に名前は書いてありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Then it may be the one I picked up around there. Is a name written inside?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、「はる」と書いてあります。内側を見てもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 内側の名前を伝え確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, it says Haru. Could you check inside?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the name inside and ask for checking. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 名前も合っています。こちらの帽子ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: The name matches too. This is the hat, then.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、これです。拾ってくださって助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の帽子と認め礼を言って受け取る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, that's it. Thank you for picking it up; that's a great help.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Identify it as yours, thank them, and receive it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 見つかってよかったです。どうぞ、引き続き楽しんでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm glad it's found. Enjoy the rest of your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 予約された本のお受け取りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you collecting a reserved book?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、連絡をいただきました。利用者カードはこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 予約本の受け取りを伝えて利用者カードを出す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I received a notification. Here's my library card.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you're collecting a reserved book and present your library card. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの「町の台所」という本をお取り置きしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: We're holding this book, The Town Kitchen, for you.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この本は第二巻ですね。最初から読みたいので、第一巻も探しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 第二巻だと気づいて第一巻も探していると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: This is volume two. I'd like to read from the start, so I'm also looking for volume one.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Notice it's volume two and say you're looking for volume one too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 第一巻は今、貸出中です。予約を入れましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: Volume one is currently on loan. Shall I reserve it?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。第一巻が戻る前に、第二巻を返す日が来そうですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 第一巻の予約を頼み返却時期の重なりに言及する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. It looks like volume two's due date may come before volume one returns.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Request volume one and mention the return-date overlap. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 第二巻の返却日は二週間後です。順番に読むなら、今回は借りずにお帰りになることもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Volume two is due in two weeks. If you want to read in order, you can leave without borrowing it this time.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、第二巻は今日は借りません。第一巻だけ予約してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 第二巻の貸出を見送り第一巻だけ予約する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I won't borrow volume two today. Please reserve only volume one.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decline borrowing volume two and reserve only volume one. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 第一巻を予約しました。受け取りの連絡はメールでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I've reserved volume one. Is email all right for the pickup notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、メールでお願いします。届いたら取りに来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: メール連絡を選び受け取りに来ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, email, please. I'll come collect it when it arrives.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose email notification and say you'll collect the book. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました、第一巻のご用意ができましたらお知らせします。またお待ちしています。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Certainly; we'll notify you when volume one is ready. We look forward to seeing you again.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お荷物をお預かりします。お届け先はこちらでお間違いありませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: We'll take your parcel. Is this the correct delivery address?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: あ、部屋番号を書き忘れました。まだ書き足せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 部屋番号の書き忘れに気づき追記できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Oh, I forgot the apartment number. Can I still add it?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Notice the omitted apartment number and ask whether you may add it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: はい、お預かりする前ですので大丈夫です。何号室でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Yes, we haven't accepted it yet, so that's fine. Which apartment?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 三〇二号室です。住所の後ろに書けばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三〇二号室と伝え記入位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Apartment 302. Should I write it after the address?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give apartment 302 and ask where to write it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい、ここにお願いします。ご依頼主の電話番号も空欄ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes, here, please. The sender's phone number is blank too.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: こちらに携帯番号を書きます。箱の中は衣類だけです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分の携帯番号を記入し中身が衣類だと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll write my mobile number here. The box contains only clothes.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Enter your mobile number and say the contents are clothes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 衣類ですね。お届け先への連絡に使える電話番号はわかりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Clothes, then. Do you know a phone number for contacting the recipient?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 相手の番号を今、携帯で調べます。見つかったので、こちらにも書きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 相手の電話番号を調べ記入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll look up their number on my phone now. I've found it, so I'll write it here too.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Find and enter the recipient's phone number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ありがとうございます、箱はしっかり閉じてありますね。控えをお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: Thank you. The box is securely closed. I'll give you the receipt copy.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 控えは荷物が届くまで保管します。問い合わせるときは、この番号を伝えるんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 控えの保管と問い合わせ番号の使い方を確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll keep it until the parcel arrives. When inquiring, I give this number, right?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm keeping the receipt and using its inquiry number. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、控えの番号をお伝えください。ありがとうございました、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, give the number on the receipt. Thank you, and take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文はお決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you decided what to order?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 卵アレルギーがあります。注文の前に、この鶏の唐揚げについて聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 卵アレルギーを伝えて唐揚げの材料を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: I have an egg allergy. Before ordering, I'd like to ask about this fried chicken.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State your egg allergy and ask about fried chicken ingredients. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 唐揚げの衣には卵を使っています。ほかに気になる料理はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: We use egg in the chicken coating. Is there another dish you'd like to ask about?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 唐揚げはやめます。この冷ややっこには卵を使っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 唐揚げを見送り冷ややっこの卵使用を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'll skip the chicken. Is egg used in this chilled tofu?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Decline fried chicken and ask about egg in chilled tofu. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 豆腐と薬味には使っていませんが、調理器具はほかの料理と共用しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Not in the tofu or garnishes, but we share utensils with other dishes.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 卵を使う料理と同じ器具なんですね。別の器具で用意できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 器具の共用を確認し別の器具を使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: So they're the same utensils as egg dishes. Can you prepare it with separate utensils?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm shared utensils and ask whether separate ones can be used. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 専用の器具はありません。卵が付かないとはお約束できません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: We don't have dedicated utensils. We can't promise it won't come into contact with egg.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました、今日は料理の注文を見送ります。持ち帰り用に瓶入りの水だけお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 料理を見送り瓶入りの水だけ注文する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood; I won't order food today. Just bottled water to take away, please.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Decline food and order only bottled water. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 承知しました。開けずにお持ちしましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Certainly. Shall I bring it unopened?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、そのままでお願いします。材料と器具について教えてくださって、ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未開封を希望し説明に礼を言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, as it is, please. Thank you for explaining the ingredients and utensils.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Request an unopened bottle and thank them for the explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 水はこちらです。ありがとうございました、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-IKOMA-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here's your water. Thank you, and take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お参りはお済みですか。御朱印はこちらでお受けしています。
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you finished worshipping? Shrine stamps are available here.

DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい、お参りしました。御朱印をいただきたいのですが、帳面を忘れました。
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 参拝済みであることと、御朱印帳を忘れたことを伝えて御朱印を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes, I have. I'd like a shrine stamp, but I forgot my book.
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have worshipped but forgot your stamp book, and request a shrine stamp. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 紙でお渡しできます。日付は今日の日付でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-03.translation: We can give it on paper. Shall we use today's date?

DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日の日付でお願いします。帰りに折れないよう、厚紙もいただけますか。
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 今日の日付を指定し、折れないように厚紙を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-04.translation: Today's date, please. Could I have some stiff card too so it won't fold on the way home?
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify today's date and request stiff card to prevent folding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この台紙に挟んでお渡しします。初穂料は五百円です。
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll sandwich it in this backing card. The offering is 500 yen.

DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 千円札でお願いします。御朱印は袋に入れたまま保管しても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 千円札で支払い、袋に入れたまま保管できるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-06.translation: Here's a 1,000-yen note. Is it all right to keep the stamp in its bag?
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Pay with a 1,000-yen note and ask about keeping it in the bag. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 帰るまでは袋に入れていただけます。帳面に貼る際は、紙を袋から出してください。
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can keep it bagged until you get home. Take the paper out of the bag when pasting it into your book.

DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: わかりました。家で貼りたいので、のりを付ける面を教えてください。
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家で貼る予定を伝え、のりを付ける面を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I'd like to paste it at home; which side should I put glue on?
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you'll paste it at home and ask which side takes glue. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 文字のない裏面です。こちらがお釣りと、台紙に挟んだ御朱印です。
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-09.translation: The blank back. Here's your change and the stamp between the backing card.

DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 裏面ですね。ありがとうございます、このままかばんに入れて帰ります。
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 裏面に貼ると確認し、台紙に挟んだまま持ち帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-10.translation: The back, then. Thank you; I'll put it in my bag like this and go home.
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm pasting the back and say you'll take it home still in its backing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: はい、どうぞお気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-NAR-KASHIHARA-001-SHARED-11.translation: Yes, take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 展示について何かお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Do you have a question about the exhibit?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: あの木の道具の使い方がわかりません。何をする道具ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 木の道具が何に使われるのか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I don't understand how that wooden tool works. What's it used for?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask what the wooden tool is used for. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 穀物から殻を取り除く道具です。動かし方はこちらの図に載っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: It's for removing husks from grain. This diagram shows how it's operated.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この取っ手を回すんですね。図の説明を持ち帰れるものはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 取っ手の操作を確認し、図を持ち帰れるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: You turn this handle, then. Is there anything with this diagram I can take home?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Confirm the handle operation and ask about taking the diagram home. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 同じ図を載せた解説シートがあります。受付で一枚お渡しできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: There's an explanation sheet with the same diagram. Reception can give you one.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 一枚いただきたいです。道具の写真も一緒に残してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 解説シートを希望し、展示の写真を撮れるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'd like one. May I also keep a photograph of the tool?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Request the explanation sheet and ask to photograph the exhibit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この展示は撮影できますが、フラッシュはお切りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Photography is allowed for this exhibit, but turn off your flash.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: フラッシュを切ります。解説シートは展示を見終わってから受け取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: フラッシュを切ると伝え、見学後にシートを受け取れるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: I'll turn it off. Can I collect the sheet after finishing my visit?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you'll disable flash and ask to collect the sheet after viewing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、出口の受付に置いてあります。農具のシートとお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, it's at the exit reception. Ask for the farming-tool sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: では、出口で農具のシートをいただきます。図と実物を見比べてみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 出口で農具のシートを受け取り、実物と図を見比べると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-1.translation: Then I'll ask for that sheet at the exit. I'll compare the diagram and actual tool.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you'll collect the farming-tool sheet at the exit and compare the actual item and diagram. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-02-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: どうぞごゆっくりご覧ください。

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: その上着でしたら試着できます。お部屋をお使いになりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: You may try that jacket on. Would you like a fitting room?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: お願いします。通勤用に買いたいので、まずＭを着てみます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 通勤用の上着を探していると伝え、Ｍを試着する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, please. It's for commuting, so I'll try medium first.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say you're looking for a commuting jacket and try medium. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: どうぞ。袖の長さはいかがですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Go ahead. How is the sleeve length?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 袖が手にかかって少し長いです。Ｓも試していいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 袖が長いと説明し、Ｓの試着を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: The sleeves cover my hands and are a little long. May I try small too?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Explain the sleeves are long and request trying small. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: こちらがＳです。腕を前に伸ばして、肩の辺りも見てみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Here's small. Stretch your arms forward and check around your shoulders too.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 肩はきつくありませんし、袖も合います。このＳはいくらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 肩と袖が合うと伝え、Ｓの値段を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: The shoulders aren't tight, and the sleeves fit. How much is this small?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Say shoulders and sleeves fit and ask the small's price. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 三千八百円です。お色はこちらの紺でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: 3,800 yen. Is this navy color all right?

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 紺をお願いします。家で着てサイズが合わなかったら交換できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 紺を選び、購入後のサイズ交換を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: Navy, please. If I try it at home and the size doesn't fit, can I exchange it?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Choose navy and ask about post-purchase size exchange. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 未使用でタグ付きなら、レシートと一緒に七日以内にお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-0.translation: If unused with tags attached, bring it with the receipt within seven days.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: タグとレシートを残しておきます。このＳを買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: タグとレシートを残すと確認し、Ｓを購入する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll keep the tags and receipt. I'll buy this small.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Confirm keeping tags and receipt and buy small. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。袋にお入れしますので、どうぞまたお越しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-03-001-SHARED-1.translation: Thank you. I'll bag it; please visit again.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 卵アレルギーがあります。かけうどんの麺とだしに卵は入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 卵アレルギーを伝え、かけうどんの麺とだしの卵使用を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: I have an egg allergy. Is there egg in the noodles or broth of the plain udon?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: State an egg allergy and ask about egg in plain udon noodles and broth. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 手元の原材料表では、麺とだしに卵の記載はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Our ingredient list doesn't list egg in the noodles or broth.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 麺をゆでるお湯は、卵を使うほかの麺と共用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: ゆで湯を卵入りの麺と共用しているか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Is the noodle-boiling water shared with other noodles containing egg?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether boiling water is shared with egg-containing noodles. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: この店ではうどんだけをゆでていますが、盛り付けの台や器具は卵入りの料理にも使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: We boil only udon here, but the plating counter and utensils are also used for dishes containing egg.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 器具を別にしても、卵が付かないとは言い切れないということですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 器具を分けても卵の付着を否定できないか確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Does that mean even with separate utensils, you can't rule out contact with egg?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Confirm egg contact can't be ruled out even with separate utensils. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、卵が混ざらないとお約束することはできません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, we can't promise egg won't get mixed in.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: それなら今日はうどんをやめます。まだ会計はしていませんが、取り消せますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 注文を見送り、会計前の取り消しを頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Then I'll skip the udon today. I haven't paid yet; can I cancel?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Decline the order and request cancellation before payment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: はい、まだ調理していませんので取り消します。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-0.translation: Yes, we haven't cooked it yet, so I'll cancel it.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。今回は何も注文せずに帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 何も注文せずに帰ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Thank you. I'll go home without ordering anything this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you'll leave without ordering anything. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: お声がけいただきありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-04-001-SHARED-1.translation: Thank you for asking us. Take care on your way home.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 今日は苗箱を運ぶ係をお願いします。この軽トラックから下ろします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Today please carry seedling boxes. We'll unload them from this small truck.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 苗箱ですね。どこまで運べばいいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 苗箱を運ぶ役割を確認し、運搬先を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Seedling boxes, then. Where should I carry them?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Confirm the seedling-box carrying role and ask the destination. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 田んぼの入口の青いシートまでです。苗は重いので、一箱ずつ運んでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: To the blue sheet at the rice-field entrance. Seedlings are heavy, so carry one box at a time.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 一箱ずつですね。空になった箱も同じシートに置きますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 一箱ずつ運ぶと確認し、空箱の置き場を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: One at a time. Do the empty boxes go on the same sheet?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Confirm one box at a time and ask where empty boxes go. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 空箱は赤いかごに重ねてください。青いシートには苗の入った箱だけ置きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Stack empty boxes in the red basket. Only boxes containing seedlings go on the blue sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: 赤いかごがいっぱいになったら、どこへ移しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 赤いかごがいっぱいになった場合の空箱の移動先を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: When the red basket fills up, where should I move them?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask where to move empty boxes if the red basket fills. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: トラックの後ろに重ねてください。通路をふさがないよう、荷台の横は空けておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Stack them behind the truck. Leave the side of its bed clear so the passage isn't blocked.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: わかりました。田植え機の人へ直接渡すこともありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintJa: 田植え機の運転者への直接の受け渡しがあるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Understood. Will I sometimes hand them directly to the rice transplanter operator?
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.hintTranslation: Ask whether there are direct handovers to the rice transplanter operator. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.sourceJa: ありますが、機械が止まり、運転者に呼ばれてから近づいてください。今は青いシートに三箱お願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-0.translation: Sometimes, but approach only after the machine stops and the operator calls you. For now, take three boxes to the blue sheet.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: まず三箱運びます。機械には呼ばれるまで近づきません。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintJa: 最初に三箱運ぶと伝え、呼ばれるまで機械に近づかないと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll carry three first. I won't approach the machine until called.
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-1.hintTranslation: Say you'll carry three first and won't approach the machine until called. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-1.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-1.sourceJa: では、私は入口に戻ります。よろしくお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-NAR-KASHIHARA-05-001-SHARED-1.translation: I'll go back to the entrance, then. Thank you.
